channel.description: Recent content in Moral Dilemmas on Remy Chaput

item.title: Learning to identify and settle dilemmas through contextual user preferences
item.description: This paper presents a novel Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning approach to settle dilemmas, by putting humans in the loop.

item.title: Artificial Moral Advisors: enhancing human ethical decision-making
item.description: This paper presents how Artificial Intelligence could be used to help humans in their ethical decision-making tasks.

item.title: PhD Thesis
item.description: PhD thesis on Learning behaviours aligned with moral values in a multi-agent system: guiding reinforcement learning with symbolic judgments, realized at the LIRIS lab, under the supervision of Professor Salima Hassas (LIRIS), Professor Olivier Boissier (LaHC), and Dr. Mathieu Guillermin (UCLy).
